popCulture.title: Aeolus (son of Hellen)
popCulture.description: Eponymous ancestor of the Aeolians — son of Hellen and Orseis, brother of Dorus and Xuthus — not the wind-keeper of the Odyssey (Hippotades).

popCulture.title: Hellen
popCulture.description: Aeolus' father in the stemma of the Hellenes — the hinge from which Dorians, Ionians, and Aeolians take their tribal names.

popCulture.title: Aeolians
popCulture.description: The Greek dialect-tribe named for this Aeolus — Thessalian and Asiatic Aeolis as his ethnographic shadow.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Aeolus and his children)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' handbook lists Aeolus' sons and daughters by Enarete — the genealogical trunk of the Aeolid houses (Cretheus, Athamas, Sisyphus, Salmoneus, and the rest).
